description.narrative: Most earthquake-displaced people in KP and AJK will live in seismically compliant houses.

By the end of 2010: At least 85% of the 3.5 million affected people will have moved into seismically compliant houses. Progress/Status: Of the 2.91 million people in the ERRA program, those who have moved into seismically compliant houses number 1.46 million, or 50%, compared with 85% targeted at inception and 77% during implementation. The compliance level increases to 69% if only completely damaged houses are taken as the universe. The rest of the houses may or may not be compliant. Data Source: ERRA's monitoring and evaluation reports Validation by third-party monitors engaged by ERRA Baseline value:

Of the households that have moved into seismically compliant houses, more than 23% of those in KP and 31% in AJK will be women-headed households. Progress/Status: Of the 319,304 houses that have been reconstructed, 55,000 (16%) belong to female headed households (FHHs)—21,388 (7%) in KP and 33,612 (nearly 11%) in AJK. Data Source: Validation by third-party monitors engaged by ERRA Baseline value:
